nodes.label: Fast Path Existing Graph Query
nodes.rationale: If graph.json already exists and the user asks a natural-language question (not a rebuild command), skip Steps 1-5 and jump directly to graphify query to avoid unnecessary re-extraction.

nodes.label: Graphify Honesty Rules
nodes.rationale: Never invent an edge; never skip corpus check warning; always show token cost; never hide cohesion scores; never run HTML viz on >5000 nodes without warning.

nodes.label: Graph Shrink Guard
nodes.rationale: to_json returns False when new graph is smaller than existing graph.json to prevent accidentally clobbering a larger good graph with a partial extraction result.

nodes.label: Node ID Format Rules
nodes.rationale: IDs use parent_dir + filename_stem + entity, normalized to [a-z0-9_], to match AST extractor output and avoid ghost-duplicate nodes when merging semantic and structural extraction.

nodes.label: Edge Confidence Score Rubric
nodes.rationale: Discrete confidence scores (0.95/0.85/0.75/0.65/0.55) prevent the bimodal collapse to 0.5/0.85+ seen in production when continuous ranges are used. EXTRACTED always 1.0, AMBIGUOUS 0.1-0.3.

nodes.label: Cross-Language Calls Prohibition
nodes.rationale: calls edges must stay within one language — a Python function cannot calls a JS/TS symbol — because cross-language call edges are phantom artifacts with no structural basis.
